questions.question: Discuss the principles of plot construction in screenwriting with reference to causality, conflict, reversals and dramatic progression.
questions.solution_html:
• Plot: strategic selection & arrangement of events for maximum emotional & dramatic effect.
  • Causality: relationship between events, in which one action produces a consequence that
  • influences subsequent events – May be weak or strong
  • Conflict: the central force driving a story forward. It may be internal, interpersonal, social, or
  • environmental.
  • Reversal: shifts plot direction dramatically. Types: fortune changes, new knowledge, dramatic
  • change of location, power shift
  • Dramatic progression: the gradual development of tension and stakes. A screenplay typically
  • follows an exposition, rising action, climax, and resolution.
  • Causality ensures coherence, conflict provides dramatic energy, reversals maintain
  • unpredictability, and progression guides the audience towards a satisfying resolution.
  • Successful plot construction balances surprise with plausibility.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: Successful plot construction balances surprise with plausibility.
